title: ULR parser percent encoding corrupting query params
body:
It appears that the URL parser is corrupting query params by incorrectly percent encoding them.

I noticed a related comment indicating that this percent encoding may not accurately follow the spec.

For example, a URL with the query parameter `type=application/pdf` is incorrectly encoded as `type=application%2Fpdf`, which causes the server to throw an error. This behavior does not match Requests, which does not corrupt the query parameter.

Possibly related: #2721, #2723, #2856, #2863, #2864.
